Hi Alex / Priya — looping in the security/engineering details below so procurement has concrete answers for the questionnaire and SLA draft. Happy to hop on a short call if you'd prefer.

SOC 2
- Redwood currently maintains SOC 2 Type I (security) and we are in the process of completing SOC 2 Type II for the inference platform. Expected Type II issuance: Q3 2026. We can provide interim evidence (control descriptions, System Description, and recent internal audit reports) to support procurement in the meantime.

GDPR / Data subject requests
- For GDPR requests (access, erasure), we support customer-initiated workflows via the Console and API. Typical timelines: access within 7 days, erasure from primary stores completed within 30 days of verified request. We provide a point of contact for escalation and can support data export in common formats.

Deletion SLA (customer data)
- Primary storage: hard-deletion processes remove records within 30 days of a verified deletion request.
- Logical deletion vs physical: we perform immediate logical deletes (making data inaccessible) and then background jobs perform physical purge within the 30-day window.

Backups and snapshots
- Incremental backups/snapshots retained by default for 90 days.
- Backups are immutable for the retention window (to guarantee restore). As a result, data removed from primary will remain in backups until the retention period expires. We provide a documented process for emergency removal from backups on a case-by-case basis (typically requires coordination, additional validation, and can take up to 90 days to complete).
- Cold/long-term archive: if a customer requests extended archival beyond default retention, we can agree on custom terms and retention schedules in the Dedicated/Private offerings.

Log retention
- Operational logs: 365 days by default.
- Security/audit logs: retained up to 2 years (configurable for enterprise customers).
- Logs may be redacted for PII; full forensic exports are available under NDA and contractual terms.

Next steps
- We'll complete Amaya's vendor security questionnaire and return a completed XLSX by EOD Friday (2026-02-20).
- We will provide the interim SOC 2 evidence pack and the finalized one-page retention SLA for legal review.
- If you want emergency backup scrub options in the contract, indicate that in the SLA draft and we will route to engineering for feasible timelines and costs.

Thanks,
